result.rationale: The migration blindly indexes `[0]['value']` on the site_settings query for 'uncategorized_category_id'. Discourse only persists site_settings rows that deviate from the default, so on most installs no row exists, making `[0]` nil and raising NoMethodError during migration. The diff shows the fallback executes unconditionally when the embed_category join returns nothing, so the defect is plausible; the exact SiteSettings persistence behavior is external, so confidence is capped.
